answer.value: Card reports zero-shot results (via lighteval) for SmolLM3-3B versus Qwen2.5-3B, Llama3.1-3B, Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B. No extended thinking: AIME 2025 9.3, GSM-Plus 72.8, LiveCodeBench v4 15.2, GPQA Diamond 35.7, IFEval 76.7, MixEval Hard 26.9, BFCL 92.3, Global MMLU 53.5. Extended thinking: AIME 2025 36.7, GSM-Plus 83.4, LiveCodeBench v4 30.0, GPQA Diamond 41.7, IFEval 71.2, MixEval Hard 30.8, BFCL 88.8, Global MMLU 64.1. Base model results are also given, e.g. HellaSwag 76.15, ARC-CF (Average) 65.61, Winogrande 58.88, MATH (4-shot) 46.10, GSM8k (5-shot) 67.63, Ruler 64k 67.85, plus multilingual benchmarks.
quotes: All evaluations are zero-shot unless stated otherwise, and we use [lighteval](https://github.com/huggingface/lighteval) to run them.
